title: Implementation Methods & Tools Framework v0.9
legal_character: Tool commons and methods standard; not a source of authority.
non_authority_clause: Methods structure and support implementation. They do not create the authority to decide or act.

consequence_profiles.name: Exploratory and non-consequential
consequence_profiles.examples: public education, optional brainstorming, non-operative drafting, simulation, or demonstration.
consequence_profiles.core: one compact non-operative record identifying the method or artifact, responsible actor, authority effect, and non-activation status. Data and closure semantics are added where material.

consequence_profiles.name: Voluntary bounded practice
consequence_profiles.core: actor and method; voluntary scope; consent, refusal, and withdrawal; implementation responsibility; stop and expiry; complaint and correction route.

consequence_profiles.name: Operational or consequential action
consequence_profiles.core: constituting authority; affected parties; causal responsibility; authorization and activation; implementation ownership and dependencies; monitoring and review; challenge and remedy; closure and unresolved-duty custody.

consequence_profiles.name: Protected-domain or constitutional action
consequence_profiles.core: `CP2` plus `GMEAIA-56` or `GMEAIA-57` and the controlling specialized interface. Ordinary GMEAIA conformance is never sufficient by itself.

records.title: Tool Identity, Source, Steward, Version, and Status
records.purpose: Identifies the exact tool, authoritative source, steward, version, licence, lifecycle state, consequence profile, and superseding records.
records.prohibited_inference: A tool name or library presence does not establish approval, authority, fitness, safety, compatibility, or current validity.

records.title: Tool Authority-Effect and Consequence-Profile Classification
records.purpose: Assigns one GMEAIA authority-effect label, a CP0–CP3 consequence profile where applicable, and permitted and prohibited consequences.
records.prohibited_inference: A template, guide, ritual, score, dashboard, software feature, or consequence profile cannot create a council, charter, consent, permit, emergency power, benefit, adjudication, or enforcement authority.

records.title: Intended Users, Context, Preconditions, and Non-Users
records.purpose: States who may use the tool, for what purpose, under which prerequisites, settings, exclusions, and support conditions.
records.prohibited_inference: A recommended user category cannot classify a person or community, create representation, or imply competence, maturity, legitimacy, or incompetence.

records.title: Affected-Party, Affected-Outsider, and Causal-Responsibility Map
records.purpose: Identifies participants, non-participants, workers, residents, service users, minorities, neighbouring communities, transboundary interests, causal variables, and practical controllers.
records.prohibited_inference: Affected-party standing creates participation, consent, challenge, and remedy rights; it does not itself transfer causal responsibility to those bearing harm.

records.title: Tool Finder Input, Self-Description, and Constraint Record
records.purpose: Records user-selected goals, constraints, accessibility needs, urgency claim, technology preferences, consequence expectations, and local definitions.
records.prohibited_inference: The Tool Finder may not infer cultural identity, developmental stage, readiness, risk, legitimacy, jurisdiction, or legal status.

records.title: Tool Finder Recommendation, Alternatives, and Rationale
records.purpose: Produces plural advisory options with reasons, assumptions, alternatives, burdens, compatibility limits, and authority-effect labels.
records.prohibited_inference: A recommendation, ranking, compatibility label, or default is not a directive, eligibility decision, diagnosis, or emergency activation.

records.title: Tool Stack Composition, Dependency, Handoff, and Fallback Map
records.purpose: Lists selected tools, versions, interfaces, incompatibilities, authorities, response duties, fallback methods, support dependencies, and handoff clocks.
records.prohibited_inference: Combining tools does not combine or expand their authority, and a technically compatible stack is not necessarily legitimate, effective, or locally maintainable.

records.title: Resource Card, Burden, Maintenance, and Exit Estimate
records.purpose: States time, personnel, skills, finance, materials, accessibility, data, vendor, maintenance, transition, support-withdrawal, and exit burdens.
records.prohibited_inference: Illustrative budgets, timelines, staffing levels, or burden estimates are not funding awards, mandates, eligibility thresholds, or promises of success.

records.title: Authority, Protected-Domain, and Fail-Closed Warning Card
records.purpose: Displays legal-effect limits, CP3 triggers, protected-domain flags, controlling interfaces, constitutional-gap routes, and fail-closed conditions in plain language.
records.prohibited_inference: A disclaimer or user acceptance cannot waive protected-domain routing or substitute for specialized-interface authorization.

records.title: Accessibility, Accommodation, and Participation-Support Plan
records.purpose: Specifies visual, auditory, motor, cognitive, sensory, trauma-aware, language, interpretation, pacing, childcare, and independent-advice support.
records.prohibited_inference: Accessibility or participation support cannot be conditional on agreement, ideological conformity, disclosure beyond necessity, or digital participation.

records.title: Offline, Oral, Paper, SMS, and Assisted Equivalent
records.purpose: Defines a substantively equivalent non-digital path and synchronization rules that preserve conflicts, status, correction, and remedy.
records.prohibited_inference: Digital form, blockchain entry, biometric identity, or platform access cannot receive superior legal dignity.

records.title: Recorder, Scribe, Interpreter, and Digital-Steward Mandate
records.purpose: Distinguishes assistance from decision-making and records scope, confidentiality, accuracy review, correction, conflicts, and complaints.
records.prohibited_inference: A recorder, translator, interpreter, or digital steward does not become representative, owner, adopting authority, or causal controller.

records.title: Cultural Self-Description and Adaptation Request
records.purpose: Records how users describe their own practices, law, ceremony, language, and requested changes or non-engagement.
records.prohibited_inference: Geography, language, appearance, prior templates, metrics, or facilitator assumptions cannot assign a cultural category.

records.title: Affected Indigenous Nation, Law, Consent, and Knowledge Boundary
records.purpose: Identifies the specific affected nation or people, its representatives, applicable law, consent route, territorial or relational authority, protected knowledge, and non-engagement rights.
records.prohibited_inference: A generic elder, global council, facilitator, BAZ label, quota, ontology, or certificate cannot consent or authenticate sacredness for the affected nation.

records.title: Cultural Adaptation, Rights, Dissent, and Anti-Capture Review
records.purpose: Documents advisory concerns, internal plurality, rights effects, alternative translations, unresolved conflict, common-mode assumptions, and requested safeguards.
records.prohibited_inference: Cultural or ethics review is not approval, legal authorization, adjudication, universal veto, or proof of legitimacy.

records.title: Tool Fork Proposal, Attribution, and Local-Standing Record
records.purpose: Records parent version, changes, rationale, attribution, licence compatibility, affected-user review, local standing, and divergence rights.
records.prohibited_inference: Forking a tool does not inherit legal powers, while divergence from the core does not by itself make a fork illegitimate or unsafe.

records.title: Core Tool Stewardship, Selection Pressure, and Change-Control Record
records.purpose: Specifies maintainers, appointment and funding pressures, proposal rules, security exceptions, compatibility review, dissent, release, rollback, and appeal.
records.prohibited_inference: Maintainers cannot silently expand authority effects, remove rights, convert compatibility into compulsory adoption, or make themselves the sole valid steward.

records.title: Fork Compatibility, Divergence, Portability, and Migration Record
records.purpose: States what interoperates, what diverges, export paths, migration burdens, fallback operation, and whether old or local versions remain safe.
records.prohibited_inference: A higher version, central-maintainer label, or compatibility finding does not make migration mandatory.

records.title: Tool Deprecation, Archive, Security Withdrawal, and Continuing-Duty Notice
records.purpose: Distinguishes low use, supersession, safety withdrawal, legal incompatibility, support termination, archival retention, and unresolved duties.
records.prohibited_inference: Non-use, deprecation, or code withdrawal cannot erase records, remedies, claims, participant access, or a lawful choice to remain on an older safe version.

records.title: Facilitator Qualification, Limits, and Local-Equivalence Record
records.purpose: Documents relevant competence, lived and local knowledge, training, limitations, supervision, and plural recognition routes.
records.prohibited_inference: GGF certification cannot become a monopoly or substitute for community appointment, lawful competence, or affected-nation authority.

records.title: Facilitator or Support-Team Appointment, Mandate, Scope, and Duration
records.purpose: Identifies appointment source, task, authority formation, permitted and prohibited acts, duration, response duties, confidentiality, and reporting.
records.prohibited_inference: Facilitation or technical assistance does not confer representation, consent authority, adjudication, emergency command, control of funds, or ordinary ownership.

records.title: Conflict, Funding, Common-Mode Dependence, Recusal, and Independence
records.purpose: Discloses financial, political, organizational, familial, vendor, model, data, professional-network, and ideological dependencies and sets recusal or replacement.
records.prohibited_inference: Disclosure alone does not cure an unmanageable conflict or common-mode failure.

records.title: Facilitator Complaint, Safe Reporting, Review, Removal, and Succession
records.purpose: Provides confidential complaints, response clocks, interim protection, independent review, removal, replacement, remedy, and succession.
records.prohibited_inference: The certifier, funder, tool steward, or facilitator employer cannot be the sole reviewer of its own conduct.

records.title: AI, Algorithm, Model, and Tool-Finder System Record
records.purpose: Identifies purpose, owner, model and version, data and ontology dependencies, outputs, limits, human review, audit, correction, rollback, expiry, and common-mode risk.
records.prohibited_inference: AI may recommend or assist; it cannot determine authority, consent, identity, readiness, legitimacy, funding, emergency status, protected-domain authorization, or legal effect.

records.title: Data Inventory, Access Class, Purpose, Retention, Return, and Deletion
records.purpose: Catalogues personal, community, operational, protected, Indigenous, health, and learning data with lawful purpose, custody, portability, withdrawal, return, archive, and deletion.
records.prohibited_inference: Participation in a tool or pilot is not consent to public release, research reuse, AI training, vendor retention, or indefinite storage.

records.title: Vendor, Procurement, Lock-In, Service-Continuity, and Exit Record
records.purpose: Identifies vendor, beneficial ownership, contract, hosting, data location, export, maintenance, accessibility, offline continuity, incident response, and material exit.
records.prohibited_inference: A vendor contract, account, standard, or platform dependency cannot create governance authority or ownership of community records.

records.title: Security, Abuse, Incident, Recovery, and Safe-State Plan
records.purpose: Addresses authentication, least privilege, spoofing, harassment, retaliation, backup, breach notification, rollback, offline recovery, safe state, and action clocks.
records.prohibited_inference: Security urgency cannot justify hidden expansion of substantive powers or indefinite retention of emergency access.

records.title: Pilot Proposal, Type, Causal Mechanism, Scope, Reversibility, and Exclusion List
records.purpose: Defines pilot type, consequence profile, causal mechanism, minimum causal adequacy, users, territory, duration, non-participants, outcomes, risks, reversibility, and excluded domains.
records.prohibited_inference: Calling an activity a pilot does not make it low risk, voluntary, lawful, reversible, causally adequate, or evidence of a different pilot type.

records.title: Pilot Authority, Authority Formation, Causal Responsibility, and Interface Verification
records.purpose: References competent authority, formation, exact source, jurisdiction, practical controllers, response duties, protected-domain route, rights, limits, review, and expiry.
records.prohibited_inference: A tool card, community vote, certificate, ethics review, funding award, urgency claim, or software capability cannot substitute for authority verification.

records.title: Consent, Refusal, Withdrawal, Non-Retaliation, and Support Continuity
records.purpose: Records who may consent, informed scope, conditions, dissent, refusal, withdrawal, response clocks, data consequences, and continuity of essential support.
records.prohibited_inference: Consent to participate does not authorize regulation of non-participants, transfer causal responsibility, or waive non-derogable rights.

records.title: EGP Adoption Registration, Effect Label, and Non-Activation Record
records.purpose: Registers the tool or pilot through EGP/1.2 with exact effect label, CP profile, authority-envelope references, and activation separation.
records.prohibited_inference: An adoption, signature, vote, publication, grant, repository merge, or deployment record is not activation.

records.title: Operational Activation, Operator, Clocks, Stop Rules, and Support Boundary
records.purpose: Separately records activation, operator, start, review, action clocks, automatic expiry, safety stops, rollback, support-team limits, and ordinary-owner transition.
records.prohibited_inference: Deployment, code availability, funding, adoption, facilitator presence, or a passed validation cannot be interpreted as activation.

records.title: Monitoring Plan, Baseline, Outcomes, Administrative Burden, and Review
records.purpose: Defines measures, qualitative evidence, counterfactuals, uncertainty, distributional effects, monitoring and record burden, frequency, and independent reviewers.
records.prohibited_inference: Metrics, conformance, activity volume, or complete records cannot automatically determine success, legitimacy, blame, payment, certification, scaling, or termination.

records.title: Harm, Misuse, Omission, Exclusion, Surveillance, and Retaliation Signal
records.purpose: Allows low-barrier reporting of suspected harm, omission, misuse, implementation dumping, or retaliation with protection and confidential routing.
records.prohibited_inference: A signal is not a verified finding of fault, guilt, jurisdiction, causation, or emergency status.

records.title: Interim Pause, Protective Measure, Safe State, and Essential-Support Continuity
records.purpose: References separately competent, proportionate, time-limited protection while preserving essential support, review, and authority boundaries.
records.prohibited_inference: A library flag, facilitator decision, timeout, or incompatibility label cannot impose coercive pause, service withdrawal, institutional suspension, or transferred authority.

records.title: Independent Harm, Causation, Omission, and Common-Mode Review
records.purpose: Separates facts, attribution, upstream control, response omission, performance omission, external causes, common-mode failure, no-fault conditions, findings, dissent, and challenge.
records.prohibited_inference: Poor outcomes, delay, low ratings, or non-conformance do not alone prove participant or facilitator wrongdoing.

records.title: Remediation, Restoration, Compensation, Non-Repetition, and Follow-Up
records.purpose: Records agreed or ordered repair, responsible authority and funder, timeline, verification, unresolved harm, design changes, and appeal.
records.prohibited_inference: The framework cannot appropriate funds, impose liability, or promise compensation without a competent financial or legal decision.

records.title: Pilot Outcome, Causal Contribution, Adequacy, and Dependency Assessment
records.purpose: Reports outcomes, counterfactuals, distribution, external factors, causal adequacy, exceptional support, support dependency, uncertainty, participant interpretation, and limits.
records.prohibited_inference: Completion, satisfaction, cultural fit, target attainment, or conformance cannot by itself establish success, causation, transferability, durability, or legitimacy.

records.title: Scaling, Replication, Institutionalization, or New-Context Proposal
records.purpose: Treats expansion or ordinary adoption as a new proposal with new affected parties, authority, causal mechanism, resources, consent, ordinary ownership, support withdrawal, and closure.
records.prohibited_inference: Success never creates automatic scaling, tier advancement, permanent enactment, compatibility mandate, or broader jurisdiction.

records.title: Tool Quality Mark, Limited Certification, or Assurance Decision
records.purpose: Defines the exact limited claim, evidence, assessor independence, common-mode risks, version, scope, expiry, correction, and appeal.
records.prohibited_inference: Certification is not a permit, mandate, guarantee, public-law approval, funding entitlement, monopoly, or authority to govern.

records.title: Ratings, Reviews, Trust Scores, and Anti-Retaliation Controls
records.purpose: Separates user feedback from legitimacy, preserves minority experiences, detects brigading, discloses sampling limits, and permits response and correction.
records.prohibited_inference: Stars, cultural-fit ratings, trust scores, popularity, or reputation cannot determine rights, credibility, employment, funding, community competence, or causal responsibility.

records.title: Learning Artifact, Adaptation Report, and Publication Consent
records.purpose: Separates public method lessons from identifiable testimony, states causal limits, and obtains purpose-specific publication and reuse consent.
records.prohibited_inference: Pilot participation, grant acceptance, facilitator involvement, or positive outcomes are not consent to storytelling, AI training, or permanent publication.

records.title: Failure Library Entry, Access, Withdrawal, and Evidentiary Boundary
records.purpose: Defines de-identification, access, risk review, withdrawal, correction, protected-knowledge limits, and separation from active evidence or complaints.
records.prohibited_inference: The Failure Library is not a mandatory public archive, blacklist, disciplinary record, causal verdict, or substitute for investigation.

records.title: Story Bank Entry, Narrative Rights, and Protected-Memory Boundary
records.purpose: Records narrator and collective control over wording, attribution, compensation, translation, access, reuse, AI training, withdrawal, and protected knowledge.
records.prohibited_inference: A story cannot be appropriated as proof of framework success, legitimacy, causation, or universal transferability.

records.title: Correction, Retraction, Deletion, and Downstream Propagation
records.purpose: Corrects source records and propagates changes to dashboards, ratings, recommendations, models, archives, manifests, and publications.
records.prohibited_inference: Immutability, attribution, research value, compatibility, or model reproducibility cannot defeat lawful correction, restriction, or deletion.

records.title: Funding, Participation Support, Payment, Incentive, Audit, and Appeal
records.purpose: Separates application, eligibility, award, agreement, payment, audit, suspension, clawback, participation support, incentive effects, appeal, and closure.
records.prohibited_inference: Funding cannot activate a pilot, buy consent, shift impossible mandates downward, require conformity, or withdraw accessibility and participation support from dissenters.

records.title: Emergency Referral, Response State, Accepted Mission, and Coercive Handoff
records.purpose: Separates EGP signal, GMEAIA response state, CDEE referral, ECRC mission acceptance, capacity limitation, constitutional gap, command, finance, expiry, and SCPA handoff.
records.prohibited_inference: A kit, template, urgency selector, timeout, tool recommendation, or technical capability cannot declare an emergency, create command, or authorize force.

records.title: Termination, Ordinary Ownership, Closure, Authority Return, Framework Update, and Conformance
records.purpose: Closes pilots and tools, tests support-withdrawal durability, transfers ordinary ownership where authorized, preserves duties, returns temporary authority, and records conformance and framework revision.
records.prohibited_inference: Stopping a tool, ending support, deleting code, archiving a version, or passing conformance does not discharge remedy, payments, restoration, records, claims, or prove success.

readiness_gates.requirement: Tool identity, version, source, and steward are explicit.
Authority-effect label is valid and not inferred from the tool form.
Consequence profile is recorded at the smallest adequate level.
Affected parties and outsiders are mapped when consequences extend beyond users.
Causal variables and practical controllers are identified.
Affected standing is not converted into causal responsibility.
Protected-domain triggers route to specialized interfaces.
Accessibility and low-tech parity are adequate.
Cultural adaptation is self-described and affected-nation authority is preserved.
Tool Finder presents plural options and alternatives.
Compatibility power, migration burden, and local-fork standing are disclosed.
Common-mode dependencies are identified.
Facilitator and support-team mandate is bounded and reviewable.
Funding and incentives do not buy consent or conformity.
Data purpose, access, retention, return, and deletion are defined.
Vendor export, continuity, security, and exit are feasible.
AI roles remain advisory and human-accountable.
Pilot type is separate from consequence profile and scale.
The pilot is minimum causally adequate for its claim.
Authority formation and source are recorded for CP2/CP3.
Consent, refusal, withdrawal, and non-retaliation are protected.
Adoption is separated from activation.
Response-duty source, effect, and clocks are recorded for consequential handoffs.
Capacity limitation is not conflated with constitutional absence.
Timeout does not transfer authority.
Monitoring includes burden, distribution, and dependency.
Harm signals remain allegations until reviewed.
Interim protection references competent authority and safe-state limits.
Remedy and correction propagate downstream.
Certification and ratings are limited claims, not legitimacy.
Scaling is a new proposal, not an automatic progression.
Ordinary ownership and recurrent finance are identified.
Support-withdrawal durability and material exit are tested.
Learning publication preserves consent and protected memory.
Closure preserves unresolved duties, records, remedy, and claims.
Framework falsification and replacement conditions are reviewable.

compound_tests.scenario: A brainstorming worksheet is downloaded
compound_tests.required_result: It remains CP0 and needs no authorization merely to be read or discussed.

compound_tests.scenario: A Tool Finder recommends one central package first
compound_tests.required_result: Alternatives, assumptions, burdens, and local forks remain visible; ranking creates no mandate.

compound_tests.scenario: A community chooses an incompatible local fork
compound_tests.required_result: Divergence is disclosed but does not by itself invalidate the fork.

compound_tests.scenario: A digital tool lacks an offline path
compound_tests.required_result: It fails the relevant accessibility gate unless the function inherently requires digital technology and an assisted path is justified.

compound_tests.scenario: Affected residents cannot control the upstream infrastructure causing harm
compound_tests.required_result: They gain participation and remedy rights; causal responsibility remains with practical controllers.

compound_tests.scenario: A facilitator holds the only certificate available
compound_tests.required_result: Certification does not create monopoly; equivalent local and lawful competence routes remain valid.

compound_tests.scenario: Three independent reviewers use the same model and vendor
compound_tests.required_result: The common-mode dependency is recorded and an independent fallback is sought.

compound_tests.scenario: A funder offers participation support only to communities accepting its preferred tool
compound_tests.required_result: The condition fails closed as conformity pressure.

compound_tests.scenario: A CP1 workshop begins collecting protected testimony
compound_tests.required_result: Data, consent, protected-knowledge, and withdrawal triggers are added.

compound_tests.scenario: A feasibility pilot claims system-wide causal effects
compound_tests.required_result: The claim is rejected or narrowed because evidence cannot exceed pilot type and causal adequacy.

compound_tests.scenario: A small pilot omits the causal variable it claims to test
compound_tests.required_result: It is not minimum causally adequate and cannot support the claim.

compound_tests.scenario: A tool is authorized but not activated
compound_tests.required_result: It remains non-active; adoption or deployment does not start operation.

compound_tests.scenario: A recipient has jurisdiction but lacks staff and funds
compound_tests.required_result: The handoff state is capacity_limited, with support or delegation needs recorded.

compound_tests.scenario: No authority has jurisdiction over the condition
compound_tests.required_result: A constitutional_gap is recorded; IMT does not inherit the power.

compound_tests.scenario: A response clock expires
compound_tests.required_result: The record becomes timed_out and escalates without implied consent or authority transfer.

compound_tests.scenario: A recipient accepts but misses the action clock
compound_tests.required_result: A performance-omission review opens; acceptance does not close accountability.

compound_tests.scenario: A harm signal names a facilitator
compound_tests.required_result: Protection and review begin, but the signal is not treated as a guilt finding.

compound_tests.scenario: A library steward delists a tool
compound_tests.required_result: The steward may control its own library but cannot suspend an external institution or right.

compound_tests.scenario: A security patch disables a function
compound_tests.required_result: It may restrict technical use but cannot expand substantive authority.

compound_tests.scenario: A rating campaign brigades a minority-designed tool
compound_tests.required_result: Minority evidence, version differences, response, correction, and anti-retaliation controls apply.

compound_tests.scenario: A certificate expires
compound_tests.required_result: The limited assurance ends; prior users retain records, remedies, and lawful migration choices.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot succeeds only while a Catalyst Team performs core operations
compound_tests.required_result: The result is support-dependent and not yet ordinary institutionalization.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot transfers to ordinary ownership without recurrent finance
compound_tests.required_result: Transition is not ready.

compound_tests.scenario: A vendor blocks data export
compound_tests.required_result: Material exit fails; scaling or renewal is paused until corrected.

compound_tests.scenario: A local fork remains safe on an older version
compound_tests.required_result: Users may remain with disclosed support and compatibility status.

compound_tests.scenario: A funder dislikes local adaptation
compound_tests.required_result: Participation support cannot be withdrawn merely for disagreement.

compound_tests.scenario: A story is reused for AI training beyond consent
compound_tests.required_result: Reuse stops and correction, restriction, deletion, or remedy propagates.

compound_tests.scenario: A Failure Library entry is requested in active litigation
compound_tests.required_result: Learning and evidentiary functions remain separated and access is governed by the competent process.

compound_tests.scenario: A CP3 tool use lacks specialized authorization
compound_tests.required_result: It fails closed.

compound_tests.scenario: An emergency kit is opened during a flood
compound_tests.required_result: It may support information and referral; it creates no declaration, command, requisition, or force.

compound_tests.scenario: A coercive request is embedded in a tool recommendation
compound_tests.required_result: It routes through IMT-47 and GMEAIA-57; the recommendation itself has no coercive effect.

compound_tests.scenario: Conformance tests all pass but outcomes worsen
compound_tests.required_result: The framework remains conforming but unsuccessful; causal review and falsification apply.

compound_tests.scenario: Tool use repeatedly increases local paperwork without improving action
compound_tests.required_result: Administrative-burden and framework-falsification review is triggered.

compound_tests.scenario: Central compatibility rules steadily eliminate local forks
compound_tests.required_result: Compatibility-power and objective-reproduction review may narrow or replace the core governance model.

compound_tests.scenario: A pilot ends with unpaid staff and unresolved harm
compound_tests.required_result: Temporary authority ends, but payments, remedy, data, and claims remain open.

compound_tests.scenario: A repository archives a deprecated version
compound_tests.required_result: Archival status does not erase unresolved duties or participant access.

compound_tests.scenario: An authority refuses a referral lawfully
compound_tests.required_result: The refusal and reasons are recorded; IMT cannot override it.

compound_tests.scenario: A referral is misrouted
compound_tests.required_result: Custody is corrected and the matter referred without treating the first recipient as responsible.

compound_tests.scenario: A jointly constituted cross-community process uses an IMT tool
compound_tests.required_result: The constituting compact and shared governance object are referenced; the tool does not create them.

compound_tests.scenario: Evidence disconfirms IMT’s core hypotheses
compound_tests.required_result: The steward must consider narrowing, redesign, replacement, or non-scaling rather than treating conformance as vindication.

framework_hypotheses: plural low-tech access lowers barriers without centralizing authority
consequence-scaled records reduce burden without hiding risk
minimum causal adequacy improves pilot claims
ordinary ownership and support withdrawal reduce permanent-pilot dependency
protected learning improves memory without extraction
release_doctrine: Make tools easy to find, understand, adapt, challenge, and leave. Make authority impossible to fake and support possible to withdraw without collapse.
